level.name: Play through the press
level.brief: Four players. Beat two hunters with quick passes, then run at their back four and slide the 9 in.

att.name: Centre-back
att.tip: You are being hunted. Play it short to the 6 straight away.

att.name: Pivot
att.tip: No time on the ball. Aim early and play it first time to the 8.

att.name: Link
att.tip: You are past the press. Drive at the back line and slide the 9 through.

att.name: Striker
att.tip: Stay level with the last man until the 8 plays it, then run on and finish.
